releases.title: Updates only fetch what changed
notes: The kit now uses the copy you already have first, and only downloads files that are new or different.
Updates are checked against a published list of files, so a damaged download is spotted before it is used.
Nothing is changed on your computer until the whole update has been downloaded and checked.

releases.title: A short note about what changed
notes: After an update you now see a short note in plain words: which release you had, which one you have now, and how many files changed.
The note works without internet, because it is stored with the kit.
You can read it again any time: open a terminal and type secure-linux-whats-new.
